title: 13 Best Herbal Tinctures For Menstrual Cramps
description: Angelica archangelica tinctures have been traditionally used to treat menstrual cramps, with its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and analgesic properties helping to alleviate pain and discomfort. The bioactive constituents of angelica, including ferulic acid and essential oils, help to relax uterine muscles and reduce prostaglandin levels, which contribute to menstrual cramps.
